name: Amtrak
description: Amtrak (US national passenger rail) read-only: station directory and search with addresses, hours and amenities; named routes with ordered stops and train numbers; live train positions and stop-by-stop status decrypted from the public Track Your Train feed. Public feeds of www.amtrak.com and maps.amtrak.com, no login. Fares, schedules by date and booking are not covered (the /dotcom/ APIs sit behind Akamai Bot Manager).

tools.name: Get route
tools.description: Route detail after `list_routes`; the train numbers feed `train_status`, the stop codes feed `get_station`.

options.name: code
options.about: Route code from list_routes, e.g. NERG Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9]{2,8}$.

response.about: One route by code (e.g. NERG) or exact name (e.g. Northeast Regional): cities served, ordered stops with station names, and the train numbers Amtrak maps to the route.

tools.name: Live trains
tools.description: A snapshot of where trains are right now; use `train_status` for one train with its stop-by-stop times.

options.name: limit
options.about: Return at most this many trains (feed order). Default: all.

options.name: route_name
options.about: Exact route name as the feed states it, e.g. 'Northeast Regional', 'Acela' (case-insensitive)

response.about: Live positions and status of every Amtrak train currently in the tracking feed (active, pre-departure and recently completed runs): coordinates, heading, speed, route, origin/destination and last event. Decrypts the public maps.amtrak.com feed the Track Your Train map uses. Optional filters by route name, train number or state; `limit` caps the list (the output then says it is partial).

fields.name: cms_id
fields.about: Route CMS id, joins RoutesList.json

fields.name: heading
fields.about: Compass heading, e.g. NW; null when blank

fields.name: id
fields.about: Feed object id for this train run (unique per run)

fields.name: last_event_code
fields.about: Station code of the last event; null when blank

fields.name: last_valid_at
fields.about: Last GPS fix time as the feed states it; null when blank

fields.name: origin_scheduled_departure
fields.about: Local time at the origin, 'M/D/YYYY h:mm:ss AM/PM' as the feed states it

fields.name: state
fields.about: Active, Predeparture or Completed as stated by the feed

fields.name: status_message
fields.about: Service message; null when blank

fields.name: updated_at
fields.about: Feed record update time as the feed states it

fields.name: velocity_mph
fields.about: Speed reported by the feed (mph); null when blank

tools.name: Search stations
tools.description: Find a station code when you know a place name or a partial name; `get_station` for full detail.

options.name: q
options.about: Search term: city, station name, alias or code

response.about: Station finder autocomplete of amtrak.com: free-text search by station name, city, alias or 3-letter code. Returns matching stations with street address and coordinates. Non-station place suggestions the geocoder returns are counted, not listed.

fields.name: address
fields.about: Street address from the station finder; null when the finder has no record for the code.

fields.name: code
fields.about: 3-letter station code

fields.name: display_name
fields.about: Autocomplete label, e.g. 'Chicago, IL - Union Station (CHI)'

fields.name: geo
fields.about: WGS84 coordinates from the station finder; null when unavailable.

fields.name: match_type
fields.about: How the term matched: name, code, alias, city ... as the source states it

fields.name: name
fields.about: Station name, e.g. 'Chicago, IL'

fields.name: rank
fields.about: Station rank from the source; null when blank

tools.name: Train status
tools.description: Train status by number, the Track Your Train equivalent. Train numbers come from `get_route` or `live_trains`.

response.about: Status of one train number from the live tracking feed: every run of that number currently tracked (a long-distance number can be tracked on two consecutive service days), each with position, state and stop-by-stop scheduled, estimated and actual times with delay comments.
